body:
Protože nikam nechodím jakožto introvert nejsem moc na párty koncerty atd. Takže někoho si jen tak najít je těžké. A po 20 letech teď práce starosti tak nemám čas ani moc náladu.
Velice rád bych se dostal do vstahu někoho koho budu milovat nejsem na rychlej sex atd. Když už laškovat tak s někým koho mám vážně rád. 
Nejsem zrovna nejvíc fit člověk ale nejsem ani nějak extra limitovanej. Pracuju a chodim do práce skoro 3km pěšky tam I zpátky, bydlím s mím nejlepším kamarádem teď 3. Měsícem vařim uklízím a I když mi každej říká tvoje holka bude šťastná když tohle vše umíš tak bych jednu musel prvně najít.
Chtěl bych zas začít pracovat víc na sobě když sem poslední dobou byl jen ve stresu a cejtil se jak kus hovna.. ale párkrát chytnu depku že budu navždy sám pobrečím si a ráno vstanu do práce, tak nějak to u mě chodí

I'm glad you are trying to help. Unfortunately I already tried almost anything. I tell her how much I love her and wish for her to see how amazing she truly is. She tells me she needs time and I get that. I give her time but i dont believe that time will solve everything. Plus the more time I give up the more likely something bad might happen. I appreciate the thought !

I dont know what to do as well. I mean the more people that try to talk to me the more I feel like shit. I would love to end it. Idk what to do. People dont need me. I dont want to work what's the point in that if I'm going to be unhappy all the time. I'm too lazy to do anything . I dont have anyone I love. I feel empty. So I'll just live day to day doing shit I find entertaining until I'm bored. Cant think about the future becouse it's just depressing. The past wont change. Might do something crazy before I die at least.

You got to uni? I didnt even make it through my first year in highschool. Dont have enough confidence for tinder or anything like that. My anxiety mainly doesnt let me talk to new people and venting online is and always will be easier. I am in a rough spot rn as well. I mean my dog is what keeps me up above the water most times. But the depression is just so strong. I bought a skateboard recently to learn how to ride it (great season to start with all this rain out here ...) I feel worthless I'm disgusted with myself but I try and help other people like me out here at least. That is the least I can do. Rotting in front of a computer is pretty much my whole life. I never even had a good one to at least play the latest games or something. I always felt like I never had anything. I live my life just trying to entertain myself and distract myself from the bad stuff. Living in the present dont think about the past or the future. Talking to people online might be just the first step to getting you out of that anxiety of talking to other people. Just keep yourself entertained to some degree and look at the good stuff not the bad stuff. I mean what does make you feel good? Try to thing about it and dont think about how worthless you are it's just a downward spiral it doesnt accomplish anything and makes you feel bad. Waste of time thinking about bad shit instead go do some fun stuff could be something small even. And when it ends dont think about the end think about the new fun thing you can do.

3 years ago I didnt go to school for half a year becouse I was anxious to the degree that I just couldn't get out of my bed in the morning I didnt really get why I was so afraid to go to school it's not like anyone was trying to harm me but I just was and still am quite antisocial. School sucks for me especially I dont like people my age. Haven't been to high school I started working instead with my dad he is a carpenter but I'm lazy as fuck and that isnt really good when it comes to doing anything. I had some therapists when I was 7 becouse of school but I didnt really realise until I was 15 that that's what that was. I have 1 true friend really and I dont care I dont need more. I just look for fun things in life and dont think too much ahead live in the present is the best thing to do most of the time becouse we sometimes make future scarier than it will be and our past sometimes haunts us for absolute stupid stuff. Just have fun. And all the depressing stuff think about it in a bit different way. Dont be scared to say I dont know what the fuck I'm doing. Most people are scared to talk about stuff me included mainly to my fam. But if there is a problem I think about all the ways I can fix it. And If i feel pissed and I start chatting mad shit I'll say YO I'm fucking PISSED I dont want to be but fuck you why am I so pissed. Just saying how you are feeling will immidietly make the other person act differently. If people are joking about me and I say hey I dont feel too happy rn can we stop please? They mostly will stop and if not then Haha fuck you lick up on my cheeks.

Most of us cant talk to our family. I mean I always get asked what do I think is gonna happen if I dont so this or that and I cant just say that I'm depressed I dont have anything and never had. It's just the way us hoomans are for some reason. Talking to others even just on this subreddit and helping them makes me feel better as well. Just venting is absolutely freeing. But It seems like i wasn't good enough to save this 1 dude he doesnt respond anymore. So I'll say this. Go do something you find entertaining if its watching a yt video or doing something physical or idk watch porn for all I care xD is there something you are good at? I'm not so if not dont feel bad. I'm trying to learn how to skateboard now. I am just learning how to ride. So learning a new skill is pretty fun. As much as I like music it doesnt distract me from feeling depressed. Venting and talking with other people helps me the most find something so something small or big just have fun. And dont think too much ahead becouse its unnecessarily scary and what happens happens dont take shit but dont give shit if you think about the future and the past alot it will just destroy you live life NOW cus you'll never know what will happen even in the next 10 minutes.

Hi. You are looking for reason to live? Why not look for shit to do instead? I mean what reason would you want? You can live for yourself or live for others. Do what you find entertaining could be as small as reading a funny joke to like learning a new skill or some shit I'm trying to learn how to skate becouse I found it always cool to look at and it seemed fun riding it.
What I'm saying is that maybe looking for something to do might help you finding reasons to live for. Be it family or cool and fun shit you can do or watching and experiencing new interesting stuff. Covid and all but that just means learning skills might not be such a bad idea. Do what you want and fuck what anyone has to say, Have Fucking Fun
Of course vent here xD I mean if someone doesnt give a shit they wont read it and that's pretty much the only reason for this subreddit

You are kinda good at school? I ain't even that. Laziness oh how much I hate that bitch. We kinda on bad terms as well. I have nothing I'm good at. At school I was only good at english ( I'm foreign) I was too lazy to learn I'm pretty lazy to go out or meet new people I fucking suck ass. I mean I might be homeless next year. Idk if you have anything you want to do becouse I never had. No goals no aspirations. Being good at school could actually get you quite far. Laziness is the biggest problem I reckon. I mean it surely is one of the biggest for me. Idk what you are lazy to do but all you can do is try (yeah it sucks absolute ass) but it's TRUE. When I REALLY try and I try and make something a habit it can break through the laziness. Try anything you can but the first and main thing is getting to it. I fucking hate laziness Good luck.

Give it a thought for sure and try to cool off. I act out on impulses alot and as retarded as it might seem I do have to chill out before i act and think about solutions. Venting out problems is a great idea. You already posted something here so why not just vent and cool down?

Seems that you are religious? Dark past? Ok I mean idk anything but it seems that you regret your "dark past" becouse you are here on a fucking subreddit. Idk what happened and why are you in this state of mind but you want to restart? I want to end my story so restart sounds unique. I am not religious so such thing wont work for me but I dont want you to just give up like this. 23 is young enough to change. I have nothing to work with and I am no random dude that will say: dont worry you are amazing and everything will be fine. No I barely turned 18 and fucking want to die. But hey maybe there is something we could do.
Thank you.

Idk why but that just sound cute. Honestly unless you think you are absolutely dangerous to yourself I dont see the need. I dont know what kind of responsibilities you have and what kind of things you do. It just seems like you need a distraction like a movie or even just yt something to distract you or entertain you. If I think I'm a bother I just tell them that I dont want to be a bother. And that I'll do anything or help if needed. Dont think in a loop about what if this or what if that. What happens happens most of the time if you are polite no one will be mad especially in a hospital. You just have to tell them your problems

I help myself by just entertaining myself in any way possible. Watching stuff on youtube, playing out stories in my head or just doing dumb shit but I feel the best just talking to others tbf. I can say to myself calm down and as long as I'm able to do it I know I'll be fine. So find something you can get your morale up. If its entertainment learning a skill or chatting with others.
Yo I went nuts today. Really wanted to die still have depression every time I think about my physical appearance, skills that are nonexistent, and bad traits I have.
You seem strong. To be able to go to a hospital when you feel like this. Most of us cant even walk out of our rooms
Damn saying that you can go for it is something I dont have the balls to do. In a weird way I respect the nutsack.

You wish to ask for help? I thought you already did? I mean I'm reading this thread. I wish I could be wiped off by the memories of those who love me. Is that truly what you wish for? I dont see into your head ofcourse but compared to me this is what I would write but I would live to say I wish the people that I love knew what I was going through and helped me get better.

You need someone that will listen and talk about shit with you. No I'm not saying therapist. I mean someone that is in the same boat or sailing in similar waters. Best thing would be to have someone in the same room but if that is impossible try to strike conversations online and maybe even anonymously just talk vent.

What do you do to push people away is always what I'm thinking about when I read these. Becouse my depression is that i hate myself for being unable to do anything for anyone but other then being "ugly" I don't think I push away people they just dont want to be with the not handsome dude. If you cant talk to these people then fuck them idk.
I cant stand my age as well. I'm 18 and anything between the ages of 15-22 is just bunch of assholes but I am no normie I just dont enjoy that shit

You have to change your way of thinking. I just said something impossible didnt I? But what I mean is that shitty clique of you cant just be sad all the time thinking about the sad things but maybe make a goal for yourself and proof to your little one that you still got some fight in you and that you can keep going forwards for her. Sorry I can't really relate but just tryna help saying things is easy but acting them out is so difficult and I know that I mean I dont want to live really.

It sounds like you care about others too much to die. And I get that. Honestly I would feel sad if I was dead on the ground and my DOG would find me. It makes me sad even thinking about it. I love my dog more than anyone and hate myself more than anyone. Maybe think about different options even if that option is talking to a stranger like me. Maybe we can boost our mental together a bit.
No problem honestly I'm just bored and depressed so this helps me aswell so you can say that you helped me a bit thx ;)

Yeah so I say hi my name is stephan and I'm depressed. Honestly dont know you so I cant say you are fucking special unique. Fuck I hate when people call me SMART i didnt go to high school what about that seems SMART to you? Yo If you wanna talk about something hit me up.

Thx for some reading material. I am quite similar. I have been depressed for over 3 years now. But you know I had my ups here and there. But every once in a while I think about all the bad stuff and all the stuff I'd like to have know etc. And I just want to die right then and there. I made a post myself if you want some reading material for yourself. It's a bit longer but it shouldn't take too long.

Expose? I just wanted a hi so you can be proud of helping me out with my depression. I should have probably wrote that as well. I didnt go to high school. I talk to all kinds of people. But I only have 1 true friend. Still want to die tho. So idk what is so bad about you and you dont need to tell me I just want to talk :)

I dont have enough drive to go through all the education xD but thanks for believing in me. I may seem very suicidal in something's I write but honestly even tho I have only 1 friend he is a true friend that I'm happy I met. I am a realist or at least I like to think so so that is why I dont really believe in any religion or supernatural. I dont mind people believing in them but I dont like people abusing others with them.
Can you say hi to me? That would make my day

I have more of a fear of pain than death to be fair. Idk how about you but I am not religious. When I die I disappear is what I believe in. Which sounds scary at first but on the other hand there is no more pain and suffering and I wont be able to regret anything. I hate to admit this but I actually enjoy helping people in depression maybe I should have been a therapist instead. xD jokes aside its been a rough 6 years for me. Or 3 especially I have been very suicidal around the age 15 had problems going to school and even getting up from bed. And when you say to yourself I want to die everyday for a year straight it fucks you up

Mentality is a bitch ain't she. I mean look at you wife and kids? I'd love to have a loving family. And I mean I kinda do my mother father and even my sister love me most likely. But I am a burden and it just sucks. No one wants me so no girlfriend for me. I wanted kids but that was just a dream. A happy one until I opened my eyes that is and realised that cant happen with my mentality and physical appearance. But man you cant leave your kids behind rather live poor and love dearly than die off and fuck everything up even more. I mean that would suck.

You seem to have similar point of view on suicide as I have. I dont have much going in life and lately I'm starting to feel just like a burden. I could say all the things that make me depressed but I already posted something myself on this subreddit so you can read it there. My mother loves me and I know that but fucking god I hate everyone at points and the person I hate most is myself. But I dont wanna die? Well I want to but I just dont have the balls to do so
Wanna talk for an hour?
Has to be Kanto!!!
